name: WhatAlead Integration for Setlyy
author: devwhatalead

sections.description:
WhatAlead Integration for Setlyy connects your WordPress website to Setlyy, your AI-powered WhatsApp sales assistant.

Once connected, the plugin can automatically add the Setlyy WhatsApp widget to your public pages. Visitors can start a WhatsApp conversation with your Setlyy assistant, which is configured from your Setlyy account to welcome visitors, ask qualifying questions, explain your offers, collect useful information, trigger follow-ups, and route qualified leads to your team or booking flow.

The integration is managed directly from the WordPress admin:

  • secure one-click connection between WordPress and Setlyy;
  • automatic synchronization of your WhatsApp number and widget configuration;
  • one-click toggle to enable or disable the widget on public pages;
  • tracked campaign links for WordPress buttons and page builders;
  • shortcodes for campaign links and CTA buttons;
  • support for Setlyy website CTA formats such as floating WhatsApp buttons, QR code CTAs, and banners when configured in Setlyy;
  • campaign links for organic, social, and website CTAs;
  • tracking-friendly links so Setlyy can attribute conversations to campaigns;
  • configuration updates managed from Setlyy without editing WordPress theme code.

Setlyy is designed for businesses that use WhatsApp to qualify leads, answer website visitors, track CTA performance, run follow-ups, and improve conversion from organic, social, and website traffic.

Setlyy is a SaaS product. You need an active Setlyy account to use this plugin.

How it works

  1. Install and activate WhatAlead Integration for Setlyy on your WordPress site.
  2. Click Connect Setlyy inside Settings > Setlyy.
  3. You are redirected to Setlyy to authorize the connection.
  4. Setlyy returns a secure installation code to WordPress.
  5. The plugin exchanges that code with Setlyy and stores the connection settings.
  6. WordPress can then load the Setlyy widget script and fetch the latest widget and campaign link configuration.
  7. You can copy tracked campaign links into WordPress buttons, page builders, menus, landing pages, or shortcodes.

Features

  • Secure Setlyy connection flow from the WordPress admin.
  • WhatsApp AI widget embedded on public pages.
  • AI sales assistant configured inside your Setlyy account.
  • Floating WhatsApp button, QR code CTA, and banner CTA support through Setlyy widget configuration.
  • Campaign and social CTA links synchronized from Setlyy.
  • Tracking links for organic and social campaigns.
  • Refresh data button to pull the latest campaign links.
  • Simple on/off toggle for the website widget.
  • Shortcodes for campaign URLs and buttons.
  • No manual API token, endpoint, or technical ID entry required.

External service

This plugin connects to the external SaaS service Setlyy.

The plugin may request data from:

  • https://agent.setlyy.com

The Setlyy service provides:

  • the OAuth-style connection flow used to connect WordPress to your Setlyy account;
  • the JavaScript widget loaded on your public pages;
  • the widget configuration for your Setlyy assistant;
  • your WhatsApp number and CTA display settings;
  • tracked campaign links for website, organic, and social CTAs.

When you connect or refresh the plugin, WordPress sends the connection code, the connected agent ID, and the site URL to Setlyy so Setlyy can identify the correct workspace and return the current widget and campaign configuration.

Conversation handling, WhatsApp assistant behavior, lead qualification, tracking, and follow-ups are managed by your Setlyy account.

To use this plugin, you must accept Setlyy’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

  • Terms of Service: https://setlyy.com/cgu
  • Privacy Policy: https://setlyy.com/politique-confidentialite

Data handling and privacy

What data is stored in WordPress?

The plugin stores connection and display settings in the WordPress options table, including:

  • the connected Setlyy agent ID;
  • Setlyy endpoint URLs used by the plugin;
  • campaign links synchronized from Setlyy;
  • the latest sync timestamp and sync error message, if any;
  • the widget enabled/disabled setting.

The plugin does not store visitor conversations in WordPress. Conversations, AI configuration, qualification logic, follow-ups, and lead data are handled in Setlyy.

What data is sent to Setlyy?

During connection and synchronization, the plugin sends data needed to identify the Setlyy workspace and return the correct configuration, such as:

  • the temporary connection code returned by Setlyy;
  • the connected Setlyy agent ID;
  • your WordPress site URL;
  • plugin synchronization requests for widget and campaign link data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate WhatAlead Integration for Setlyy.
  3. Go to Settings > Setlyy.
  4. Click Connect Setlyy.
  5. Sign in or create a Setlyy account if needed.
  6. Return automatically to WordPress.
  7. Use the synchronized campaign links in your buttons or shortcodes.

After connection, the plugin enables the widget and synchronizes campaign links automatically.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Setlyy account?

Yes. WhatAlead Integration for Setlyy requires an active Setlyy account.

Is Setlyy free?

Setlyy is a SaaS product. Pricing, limits, and trial availability are managed by Setlyy.

Do I need to paste API tokens or technical IDs?

No. The connection flow handles the technical configuration automatically.

Can I disable the widget without disconnecting Setlyy?

Yes. Use the Snippet WhatsApp checkbox in Settings > Setlyy. Campaign links remain available.

How do I use tracked campaign links in page builders?

Copy a campaign URL from Settings > Setlyy and paste it into any WordPress button field, including Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, or a theme builder.

Can I use campaign links for social CTAs?

Yes. Setlyy can generate tracked links for organic, social, and website CTAs. After synchronization, those links can be copied from WordPress and used in buttons, bios, landing pages, menus, or social profiles.

Does the plugin add QR codes or banners by itself?

The plugin loads the Setlyy widget configuration. If your Setlyy account is configured to use QR code CTAs or banner CTAs, the widget can display those formats on your site.

Are shortcodes available?

Yes.

[setlyy_campaign_link slug="demo-campaign"]

[setlyy_campaign_button slug="demo-campaign" label="Parler sur WhatsApp"]
